name: 25445-visionchat-qwen2vl7b-tp2
hardware: 2x H100 80GB HBM3 (two GPUs of one a3 node, --gres=gpu:2).
parallelism: TP=2, PP=1, one in-process vLLM engine replica on one node, expert parallelism off.
architecture: Qwen2VLForConditionalGeneration (`model_type: qwen2_vl`), bf16; the rest is in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=500, bounded at 2000 requests with an 1800 s safety cap, warmup the first 25% by completion.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text` + `synthetic_image`, single turn, exactly one image per request: 68 prompt tokens (min = max), 100 output tokens (min = max), one 800x640 JPEG at quality 85 with noise content, seed 42. Under this checkpoint's preprocessor the image snaps to 812x644 and becomes 667 embedding tokens.
purpose: A photo question-answering assistant on a seven-billion-parameter model, serving 500 concurrent users short single-image prompts across two GPUs.
launch:
# vLLM engine configuration. Everything not listed here is left at this engine's own defaults.

model: Qwen/Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct

tensor-parallel-size: 2

# KEEP THIS MAPPING ON ONE LINE: the file is read line by line and an indented re-flow drops the key.
limit-mm-per-prompt: {"image": 1}

dtype: bfloat16

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
